_note: Question pack 4: random and surprising, no sports. Real items researched on 2026-10-18. Rule: only real prices (what something sells or sold for), never averages or medians.

questions.prompt: How much does Apple charge for its official Polishing Cloth?
questions.context: A small cleaning cloth for screens, sold by Apple since October 2021.
questions.imageAlt: Illustration of a soft gray cleaning cloth with a price tag
questions.explanation: Apple's Polishing Cloth costs $19. When it launched in 2021 it sold out for weeks, despite being a piece of cloth.

source.title: Apple Reveals Its Own Polishing Cloth For $19
source.excerpt: Apple's Polishing Cloth sells for a hefty price of $19.

questions.prompt: How much did the streetwear brand Supreme charge for a plain red clay brick with its logo on it?
questions.context: The brick from Supreme's Fall/Winter 2016 collection, at its original store price (not resale).
questions.imageAlt: Illustration of a red clay brick with a white label
questions.explanation: Supreme sold its logo brick for $30 in 2016. It sold out instantly and resold online for up to $1,000.

source.title: People Are Actually Paying $1,000 For This Brick On eBay

questions.prompt: How much did an original Pet Rock cost in 1975?
questions.context: The 1970s fad: an ordinary stone sold in a cardboard box with breathing holes and a care manual.
questions.imageAlt: Illustration of a smiling gray rock sitting in a cardboard box with straw
questions.explanation: The Pet Rock retailed for $3.95 in 1975. The rocks cost less than a penny each, and creator Gary Dahl sold more than a million.

source.title: Hard Sell: A History of the Pet Rock
source.excerpt: could be purchased in bulk for less than a penny, retailed for $3.95

questions.prompt: How much was admission to Walt Disney World when it opened in 1971?
questions.context: General admission to the Magic Kingdom in October 1971 (rides were paid for separately with ticket books).
questions.imageAlt: Illustration of a vintage admission ticket printed with 1971
questions.explanation: Walt Disney World opened on October 1, 1971, with admission of $3.50. Today a one-day ticket costs well over $100.

source.title: Here's what a Disney World ticket cost when it opened in 1971
source.excerpt: admission to Disney World cost just $3.50 back in the day

questions.prompt: How much did the original Nintendo Game Boy cost when it came out in the U.S. in 1989?
questions.context: The original gray handheld at its U.S. launch price.
questions.imageAlt: Illustration of a retro handheld game device with a small screen and buttons
questions.explanation: The Game Boy launched in North America in 1989 for $89.99, bundled with Tetris. Nintendo sold more than 118 million Game Boys and Game Boy Colors.
questions.notes: Secondary source; the U.S. price is widely reported as $89.99 (sometimes $89.95).

questions.context: The large black calfskin Trash Pouch, at its 2022 store price.
questions.imageAlt: Illustration of a shiny black bag shaped like a tied garbage bag

questions.prompt: How much did a still-sealed, never-opened original 2007 iPhone sell for at auction?
questions.context: A factory-sealed first-generation 4GB iPhone, sold by LCG Auctions in July 2023. It cost $499 new.
questions.imageAlt: Illustration of a white phone box still wrapped in plastic
questions.explanation: LCG Auctions sold the sealed 4GB original iPhone for $190,372.80 in July 2023, the 4GB model being rare because it was discontinued quickly.

source.title: Original 2007 4GB iPhone sells for $190,000 at auction, setting new record
source.excerpt: a 4GB iPhone from 2007, which sold for a total of $190,372.80.

questions.prompt: How much did an unopened copy of the video game Super Mario 64 sell for at auction?
questions.context: A factory-sealed, top-graded 1996 copy, sold by Heritage Auctions in July 2021.
questions.imageAlt: Illustration of a sealed video game box in a clear grading case
questions.explanation: Heritage Auctions sold a sealed Super Mario 64 for $1.56 million in July 2021, the first video game to sell for over $1 million.

source.title: Unopened 'Super Mario 64' Game From 1996 Sells for $1.56M
source.excerpt: An unopened copy of Nintendo's "Super Mario 64" has sold at auction for $1.56 million.

questions.prompt: How much did a cloth bag Neil Armstrong used to collect moon dust sell for at auction?
questions.context: The Apollo 11 lunar sample bag, which still held traces of moon dust, sold by Sotheby's on July 20, 2017.
questions.imageAlt: Illustration of a small white cloth bag with the moon behind it
questions.definition: Final auction price including buyer's premium
questions.explanation: Sotheby's sold the bag for $1,812,500 on July 20, 2017, the 48th anniversary of the moon landing. It had once been sold by mistake at a government auction for $995.

source.title: Apollo 11 Moon Rock Bag Sells for $1.8M at Sotheby's Space Auction
source.excerpt: The $1.8 million includes Sotheby's buyer's premium.

questions.prompt: How much did an artwork made of a banana duct-taped to a wall sell for at Sotheby's?
questions.context: Maurizio Cattelan's 'Comedian', sold in New York in November 2024. The buyer gets a certificate and instructions; the banana is replaced when it rots.
questions.imageAlt: Illustration of a banana on a pedestal next to an auction gavel
questions.explanation: Sotheby's sold 'Comedian' for $6.2 million in November 2024. The buyer, crypto entrepreneur Justin Sun, then ate the banana.

source.title: That Viral Banana Duct-Taped to a Wall? It Just Sold for $6.2 Million
source.excerpt: Maurizio Cattelan's viral duct-taped banana has sold for a total of $6.2 million.

questions.prompt: How much did the world's rarest postage stamp, the British Guiana 1c Magenta, sell for in 2021?
questions.context: A tiny one-cent stamp from 1856, sold by Sotheby's in New York in June 2021, price including premium.
questions.imageAlt: Illustration of an old magenta stamp with a sailing ship in a display frame
questions.definition: Final auction price including buyer's premium
questions.explanation: Sotheby's sold the British Guiana 1c Magenta for $8,307,000 on June 8, 2021. It is the only one known to exist.

source.title: British Guiana 1c magenta
source.excerpt: The stamp was put up for auction again at Sotheby's in New York on 8 June 2021, where it sold for $8,307,000.

questions.notes: Consider adding a news source (e.g. Smithsonian or AP) when verifying.

questions.prompt: How much did a single 1933 'Double Eagle' $20 gold coin sell for at auction?
questions.context: The only 1933 Double Eagle that is legal to own, sold by Sotheby's on June 8, 2021.
questions.imageAlt: Illustration of a gold coin with an eagle and the year 1933
questions.explanation: Sotheby's sold the 1933 Double Eagle for $18.9 million in June 2021, the most ever paid for a coin. Almost all of them were melted down by the government in the 1930s.

source.title: 1933 Double Eagle Sells for $18.9 Million, Setting World Record for Most Valuable Coin
source.excerpt: becoming the world's most valuable coin by selling for a whopping $18.9 million.

questions.prompt: How much did a company pay for the website address voice.com?
questions.context: Just the domain name, bought by the blockchain company Block.one in 2019.
questions.imageAlt: Illustration of a web browser address bar ending in .com with a SOLD badge
questions.explanation: Block.one paid $30 million for voice.com in 2019, one of the highest prices ever publicly reported for a domain name.

source.title: Voice.com sold for USD 30 million
source.excerpt: Last month, blockchain provider Block.one paid 30 million US dollars for the domain name voice.com.

questions.prompt: How much did Andy Warhol's 'Shot Sage Blue Marilyn' portrait of Marilyn Monroe sell for at auction?
questions.context: Christie's New York, May 2022, final price including fees.
questions.imageAlt: Illustration of a colorful four-panel pop art painting in a gold frame with an auction gavel
questions.explanation: Christie's sold Warhol's 'Shot Sage Blue Marilyn' for $195 million with fees in May 2022, the most ever paid at auction for a work by an American artist.

source.title: Warhol portrait of Marilyn Monroe fetches record-setting $195 million at auction
source.excerpt: Added fees gave it a final price of $195 million.
